disposition_reason: Reports mean, SD, range, median and quartiles of arsenic, cadmium, mercury and lead in 242 naturally gluten-free buckwheat, maize, millet, oat and quinoa products from the Polish market.

study.design: market survey with consumption questionnaire and risk assessment
study.origin: not stated per product; 78 of 242 from organic farming
study.market: local stores in Białystok, Poland and online stores
study.method: As, Cd, Pb by ICP-MS (NexION 300D; As in KED mode) after closed microwave HNO3 digestion; Hg by AAS amalgamation (AMA-254) on solid samples
lod: LOD As 0.019 µg/kg, Cd 0.017 µg/kg, Pb 0.16 µg/kg; Hg LOD not printed
study.qa: CRM INCT-CF-3 corn flour every 10 samples; recoveries As 101.5%, Cd 99.4%, Pb 100.6%, Hg 99.2%; precision 1.9-3.4%
